###########################################
## Concatenate to one df
###########################################
```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------
# Part -I: Load & view datasets
# ----------------------------------------------
all_study_files <- list.files("Data_per_study", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

data <- lapply(all_study_files, read.csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows()
```
###########################################
## Calculate sd
###########################################
```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------
# Part I: Calculate sd from CI and se
# ----------------------------------------------

for (i in 1:nrow(data)) {
  if (is.na(data$sd[i])) {
    
    ## SE to sd
    if(!is.na(data$se[i])) {
      data$sd[i] <- data$se[i]*sqrt(data$n[i])
      
    ## CI to sd
    } else if(!is.na(data$CI[i])) {
        if(data$n[i] > 60) {
          data$sd[i] <- sqrt(data$n[i])*(2*data$CI[i])/(2*1.96)
        } else {
          data$sd[i] <- sqrt(data$n[i])*(2*data$CI[i])/(2*qt(0.95, data$n[i]-1))
        }
    }
  }
}

data
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------

data %>% count(Spec) %>% arrange(Spec)

data

# ----------------------------------------------
# Data-assemblage:

# Need to purify dataset in order to NOT mismatch rows in taxonomic different groups due to differences made in the script above

data <- data %>%
  group_by(Ref, Title, Climate, Country,
         System, Specif, Org.Conv, Crop.spec, crtl_dist, Age,
         Tree.cat, Tree.pol, Tree_SR, Tree_layer, Shrub_layer,
         Metric, Spec, n, 
         grazing_spec, grazing_dens, Strip.width, Alley.width, Tree.height, Tree.diameter,
         lat_region, lng_region, lat_exact, lng_exact, Site_ID,
         Comments, Sampling_year,
         Spec_group, Overall, Crop_group, Soil_fauna, Natural_enemies, Pollinators, Pest_species, Aboveground_Arthropods, Soil_related_Arthropods,
         Arthropods, Flying_Vertebrates, Autotrophs, Ground_dwelling_Vertebrates) %>% 
  summarize(means = sum(means),
            sd = sum(sd)) %>% ungroup()
data
```

###########################################
## Treatment-Control dataset creation
###########################################
```{r}
# Per study relevant treatment-control relations have to be constructed
# Important rules herewith are that:
# 1) the AF-characteristics are taken into account: Loc_exact, d, h, tree_spec
# 2) means, sd and n are splitted in means_orig, sd_orig, n_orig and mens_crtl, sd_crtl, n_crtl
# 3) System and Specif are splitted in System_orig, System_crtl and Specif_orig, Specif_crtl
# 4) All other metrics are taken from the treatment row

# Following columns should be the same for system and metric comparability
# a) Ref
# b) Loc_region
# c) Crop_group
# d) OrgCon
# e) Sampling_Year
# f) Metric (if Metric == "div", also Comment)
# g) Spec
# h) grazing_spec

# We are interested in comparing following columns:
# i) Silvoarable tree line:
      # - Silvoarable alley: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Field margin
      # - Arable: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
      # - Field margin
# ii) Silvoarable alley:
      # - Arable: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
# iii) Silvoarable:
      # - Arable: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
# iv) Silvoarable tree line:
      # - Silvoarable alley: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Field margin
      # - Arable: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
      # - Field margin
# v) Silvopastural alley:
      # - Pasture: Org.Conv
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
# vi) Silvopasture:
      # - Pasture: Org.Conv
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
      # - silvopastoral alley: Org.Conv
# vii) Hedgerows:
      # - Field margin
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard
      # - Arable
      # - Pasture
# viii) Agroforestry
      # - Agroecosystem: Org.Conv, Crop_group
      # - Forest
      # - Orchard

# Define matching rules
matching_rules <- list(
  "Silvoarable tree line" = c("Silvoarable alley", "Arable", "Forest", "Orchard", "Field margin"),
  "Silvoarable alley" = c("Arable", "Forest", "Orchard"),
  "Silvoarable" = c("Arable", "Forest", "Orchard"),
  "Silvopastoral tree line" = c("Silvopastoral alley", "Pasture", "Forest", "Orchard", "Field margin"),
  "Silvopastoral alley" = c("Pasture", "Forest", "Orchard"),
  "Silvopasture" = c("Pasture", "Forest", "Orchard", "Silvopastoral alley"),
  "Hedgerows" = c("Field margin", "Forest", "Orchard", "Arable", "Pasture"),
  "Agroforestry" = c("Agroecosystem", "Forest", "Orchard")
)

# Initialize an empty dataframe for final output
result_list <- list()

# Make appropriate groups
# Account for the fact that Field margin, Hedgerows and Forests were not assigned with crop types or Org.Convs, therefore
df <- data %>%
  group_by(Ref, lat_region, lng_region, Sampling_year, Metric, Spec, Comments) %>%
  mutate(Index = cur_group_id()) %>%  # Assigns a unique index per group
  ungroup() %>% arrange(Index)

# df %>% dplyr::select(Index, Ref, Metric, Spec, Sampling_year, lat_region, lng_region, Comments) %>% filter(Spec == "Bats") # look for errors!!!!

# Loop over each group
# Unique group indices
group_indices <- unique(df$Index)
 
for (idx in group_indices) {
  treatment <- filter(df, Index == idx) %>% 
    filter(System == "Silvoarable tree line" | System == "Silvoarable alley" | System == "Silvoarable" | System == "Silvopasture" | System == "Silvopastoral alley" | System == "Hedgerows" | System == "Agroforestry" | System == "Silvopastoral tree line" )
  
  if (nrow(treatment) == 0) {
    next
  } 
  else {
    for (i in 1:nrow(treatment)) {
      tmp <- treatment[i, ]
      if (tmp$System == "Hedgerows") { 
        control_options <- filter(df, Index == idx) %>% 
          filter(System %in% matching_rules[[tmp$System]]) %>% 
          filter((System == "Arable") |
                (System == "Alley") |
                (System == "Field margin") |
                (System == "Forest") |
                (System == "Orchard") |
                (System == "Pasture"))
      } else {
        control_options <- filter(df, Index == idx) %>% 
          filter(System %in% matching_rules[[tmp$System]]) %>% 
          filter((System == "Arable" & Org.Conv == tmp$Org.Conv & Crop_group == tmp$Crop_group) |
                (System == "Silvoarable alley" & Org.Conv == tmp$Org.Conv & Crop_group == tmp$Crop_group) |
                (System == "Field margin") |
                (System == "Forest") |
                (System == "Orchard") |
                (System == "Silvopastoral alley" & Org.Conv == tmp$Org.Conv) |
                (System == "Pasture" & Org.Conv == tmp$Org.Conv))
        }
  
      if (nrow(control_options) > 0) {
        for (j in 1:nrow(control_options)) {
          control <- control_options[j, ]
      
          # Append matched pairs
          new <- tmp %>% dplyr::select(-System, -means, -sd, -n) %>%
            mutate(System_orig = tmp$System,
                   Specif_orig = tmp$Specif,
                   means_orig = tmp$means,
                   sd_orig = tmp$sd,
                   n_orig = tmp$n,
                   System_crtl = control$System,
                   Specif_crtl = control$Specif,
                   means_crtl = control$means,
                   sd_crtl = control$sd,
                   n_crtl = control$n,
                   crtl_dist = control$crtl_dist) %>%
            mutate(Org.Conv = ifelse(is.na(Org.Conv), control$Org.Conv, Org.Conv),
                   Crop_group = ifelse(is.na(Crop_group), control$Crop_group, Crop_group), # If Hedgerow
                   crtl_dist = ifelse(is.na(crtl_dist), control$crtl_dist, crtl_dist)) # crtl_dist is relevant when comparing Alleys with proper controls or tree rows
            
            result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- new
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
df_pairs <- bind_rows(result_list)
df_pairs

df_pairs %>% dplyr::select(Index, Ref, Metric, Spec, System_orig, System_crtl, Sampling_year, lat_region, lng_region) %>% filter(Spec == "Bats") # look for errors
```

###########################################
# Concatenate data
###########################################
```{r}
all_data <- df_pairs

# ----------------------------------------------
# PART III: Preallocate vector GROUP
# ----------------------------------------------
tmp1 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Overall == "X") %>%
  mutate(Group = "Overall") 
tmp2 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Soil_fauna == "X") %>%
  mutate(Group = "Soil fauna")
tmp3 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Natural_enemies == "X") %>%
  mutate(Group = "Natural enemies")
tmp4 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Pollinators == "X") %>%
  mutate(Group = "Pollinators")
tmp5 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Pest_species == "X") %>%
  mutate(Group = "Pest species")
tmp6 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Soil_fauna == "X") %>%
  mutate(Group = "Overall")
tmp7 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Autotrophs == "X") %>% 
  mutate(Group = "Autotrophs")
tmp8.a <- all_data %>%
  filter(Spec_group == "Aves" | Spec_group == "Lichen" | Spec_group == "Coleoptera" | Spec_group == "Herpetofauna" |
         Spec_group == "Lepidoptera" | Spec_group == "Hymenoptera" | Spec_group == "Araneae" | Spec_group == "Chiroptera" | 
         Spec_group == "Gastropoda" | Spec_group == "Fungi"| Spec_group == "Lumbricidae" | Spec_group == "Isopoda" | 
         Spec_group == "Chilopoda" | Spec_group == "Diplopoda" | Spec_group == "Microbiota") %>%
  mutate(Group = Spec_group)
tmp8.b <- all_data %>%
  filter(Spec == "Carabids" | Spec == "Staphylinids" | Spec == "Ladybugs" | Spec == "Bees" |
         Spec == "Butterflies" | Spec == "Moths" | Spec == "Wasps" | Spec == "Ants" | Spec == "Hoverflies") %>%
  mutate(Group = Spec)
tmp9 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Aboveground_Arthropods == "X") %>% 
  mutate(Group = "Aboveground invertebrates")
tmp10 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Soil_related_Arthropods == "X") %>% 
  mutate(Group = "Soil-related invertebrates")
tmp11 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Flying_Vertebrates == "X") %>% 
  mutate(Group = "Flying vertebrates")
tmp12 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Ground_dwelling_Vertebrates == "X") %>% 
  mutate(Group = "Ground-dwelling vertebrates")
tmp13 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Arthropods == "X") %>% 
  mutate(Group = "Arthropods")
tmp_1 <- rbind(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5, tmp6, tmp7, tmp8.a, tmp8.b, tmp9, tmp10, tmp11, tmp12, tmp13) %>%  
  mutate(AF_type = System_orig) %>%
  mutate(AF_type = ifelse(AF_type == "Silvoarable tree line" | AF_type == "Silvoarable alley", "Silvoarable", AF_type)) %>%
  mutate(AF_type = ifelse(AF_type == "Silvopastoral tree line" | AF_type == "Silvopastoral alley", "Silvopasture", AF_type))

# ----------------------------------------------
# PART IV: convert all types to an overall AF proxy 
# ----------------------------------------------
tmp_0 <- tmp_1 %>%
  filter(System_orig != "Agroforestry") %>%
  mutate(AF_type = "Agroforestry")

# ----------------------------------------------
# PART V: convert silvoarable tree rows to the hedgerow proxy
# ----------------------------------------------
tmp_01 <- tmp_1 %>%
  filter(System_orig == "Silvoarable tree line" | System_orig == "Silvopastoral tree line") %>%
  mutate(AF_type = "Hedgerows")

# ----------------------------------------------
# Part VI: Data-assemblage I
# ----------------------------------------------
tmp_0
tmp_01
tmp_1

MetaAnalys_data <- rbind(tmp_0, tmp_01, tmp_1)

# ----------------------------------------------
# Part VII: Data-assemblage II : convert tot SR to SR
# ----------------------------------------------
tmp <- MetaAnalys_data %>% filter(Metric == "totSR") %>% mutate(Metric = "SR")

MetaAnalys_data <- rbind(MetaAnalys_data, tmp) %>%
  dplyr::select(Ref, Title, Climate, Country,
         AF_type, AF_plottype = System_orig, Specif_orig, System_crtl, Specif_crtl, Org.Conv, Crop_group, crtl_dist, Age,
         Tree.cat, Tree.pol, Tree_SR, Tree_layer, Shrub_layer,
         Metric, Group,
         AF_mean = means_orig, AF_sd = sd_orig, AF_n = n_orig, crtl_mean = means_crtl, crtl_sd = sd_crtl, crtl_n = n_crtl,
         grazing_spec, grazing_dens, Strip.width, Alley.width, Tree.height, Tree.diameter,
         lat_region, lng_region, lat_exact, lng_exact, Site_ID,
         Comments, Sampling_year) # Order properly
MetaAnalys_data

# ----------------------------------------------
# Part VIII: Further purification: one agricultural comparator for Agroforestry + crtl_dist
# ----------------------------------------------

MetaAnalys_data <- MetaAnalys_data %>% mutate(lng_tmp = lng_exact, lat_tmp = lat_exact) %>%
  mutate(crtl_dist = ifelse(is.na(crtl_dist) & AF_plottype == "Silvoarable tree line", 0, crtl_dist),
         crtl_dist = ifelse(is.na(crtl_dist) & AF_plottype == "Silvopastoral tree line", 0, crtl_dist),
         crtl_dist = ifelse(is.na(crtl_dist) & !is.na(Alley.width), Alley.width/4, crtl_dist), # Alley width represents distance between two tree rows, so:
                             # when sampling randomly, you would expect crtl_dist to be divided between 0 and alley width/2, the mean is then alley width/4
         crtl_dist = ifelse(is.na(crtl_dist), mean(crtl_dist, na.rm = TRUE), crtl_dist)) 

MetaAnalys_data <- MetaAnalys_data %>%
  mutate(System_crtl = ifelse(AF_type == "Agroforestry" & (System_crtl == "Arable" | System_crtl == "Pasture"), "Agroecosystem", System_crtl))

# ----------------------------------------------
# Part X: Summarize over appropriate groups
# ----------------------------------------------
# Causes diluting of effect sizes, but enhances data quality
# Sums within biodiversity group to get more representative data
MetaAnalys_data <- MetaAnalys_data %>%
  group_by(Ref, Title, Climate, Country,
         AF_type, AF_plottype, Specif_orig, System_crtl, Specif_crtl, Org.Conv, Crop_group, crtl_dist, Age,
         Tree.cat, Tree.pol, Tree_SR, Tree_layer, Shrub_layer,
         Metric, Group,
         AF_n, crtl_n,
         grazing_spec, grazing_dens, Strip.width, Alley.width, Tree.height, Tree.diameter,
         lat_region, lng_region, lat_exact, lng_exact, Site_ID,
         Comments, Sampling_year) %>% 
  summarize(AF_mean = sum(AF_mean), 
            crtl_mean = sum(crtl_mean),
            AF_sd = sum(AF_sd),
            crtl_sd = sum(crtl_sd)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Ref, Title, Climate, Country,
         AF_type, AF_plottype, Specif_orig, System_crtl, Specif_crtl, Org.Conv, Crop_group, crtl_dist, Age,
         Tree.cat, Tree.pol, Tree_SR, Tree_layer, Shrub_layer,
         Metric, Group,
         AF_mean, AF_sd, AF_n, crtl_mean, crtl_sd, crtl_n,
         grazing_spec, grazing_dens, Strip.width, Alley.width, Tree.height, Tree.diameter,
         lat_region, lng_region, lat_exact, lng_exact, Site_ID,
         Comments, Sampling_year) # Order properly

# ----------------------------------------------
# Part X: Further purification: 0-values are removed
# ----------------------------------------------
# Remove when no specimen is found
# Remove when div is zero
MetaAnalys_data <- MetaAnalys_data %>%
  filter(!(AF_mean == 0 & crtl_mean == 0)) %>%
  filter(!(!Metric %in% c("ab", "totSR", "SR") & AF_mean == 0)) %>%
  filter(!(!Metric %in% c("ab", "totSR", "SR") & crtl_mean == 0))

# ----------------------------------------------
# Part XI: Addition of coordinate related data
# ----------------------------------------------
source('0) GridCoords.R')
source('0) LandCompl_SoilData.R')
plotdata # Check if procedure went well

MetaAnalys_data <- left_join(MetaAnalys_data, coords, by = c("lng_exact", "lat_exact", "lng_region", "lat_region"))
MetaAnalys_data[MetaAnalys_data == ""] <- NA
MetaAnalys_data[MetaAnalys_data == " "] <- NA
MetaAnalys_data[MetaAnalys_data == "  "] <- NA
MetaAnalys_data

saveRDS(MetaAnalys_data, "Meta-analysis full database")
```
